title: LiteLLM Gateway
description: LiteLLM proxy health, traffic, latency, providers, cost, cache, guardrails and logs. Source: monitoring/dashboards/litellm-gateway.json (git-tracked). Verify with scripts/verify_dashboard.py.

panels.title: Gateway
panels.description: blackbox probe of /health/readiness + /health/liveliness (no auth). DOWN pages via 'LiteLLM Gateway Down'.

panels.title: Metrics scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape of /metrics/ with the master-key bearer token.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: LLM requests in the selected time range (admin/UI routes excluded).

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Failed / total LLM requests in range.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: End-to-end proxy latency p95 over the range. request_timeout is 45s.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: LiteLLM-computed cost in range.

panels.title: In-flight
panels.description: Requests currently being processed.

panels.title: Cache hit %
panels.description: Redis response-cache hits / (hits + misses) in range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(litellm_cache_hits_metric_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(increase(litellm_cache_hits_metric_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(litellm_cache_misses_metric_total[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Failures / s by exception class
panels.description: LLM request failures, split by LiteLLM exception class. Empty is normal when nothing failed in the range.

panels.title: Per-model success (range)
panels.description: Success ratio, request count and spend per requested model over the range.

targets.expr: 1 - ((sum by (requested_model) (increase(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{requested_model!="",requested_model=~"$model",api_key_alias=~"$key_alias"}[$__range])) or sum by (requested_model) (increase(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{requested_model!="",requested_model=~"$model",api_key_alias=~"$key_alias"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (requested_model) (increase(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{requested_model!="",requested_model=~"$model",api_key_alias=~"$key_alias"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Provider API latency p95 by model
panels.description: Time spent waiting on the upstream provider (excludes gateway overhead).

panels.title: Time to first token p95 by model
panels.description: Streaming requests only. Empty is normal when no streaming traffic in the range.

panels.title: Gateway overhead p95
panels.description: Latency LiteLLM itself adds (auth, routing, hide-secrets guardrail, logging).

panels.title: Queue time p95
panels.description: Time a request waited before being dispatched.

panels.title: Deployment health
panels.description: LiteLLM's view of each upstream deployment: 0 healthy, 1 partial outage, 2 complete outage (pages via 'LiteLLM Provider Outage').

panels.title: Upstream failures / s by provider
panels.description: Failed calls to upstream deployments (before fallbacks). Empty is normal when providers are healthy.

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: router_settings.fallbacks activity. Empty is normal when no tier needed to fall back.

panels.title: Deployment cooldowns
panels.description: Deployments benched after allowed_fails (cooldown_time 60s). Empty is normal when nothing was cooled down.

panels.title: Smart-router classifier failures / h
panels.description: Log-derived (Promtail). Non-zero means `smart` is falling back to the heuristic scorer.

panels.title: Spend by key (range)
panels.description: Cost per virtual key alias over the range.

panels.title: Remaining key budget
panels.description: Dollars left in each key's budget period (alert below $5).

panels.title: Cost / 1k requests
panels.description: Average cost of 1,000 LLM requests over the range.

panels.title: Budget hours left (min)
panels.description: Hours until the soonest key budget period resets.

panels.title: Response cache hits vs misses / s
Provider cache-read tokens / s
panels.description: Tokens billed at cache-read price by the provider (e.g. DeepSeek) or served from Redis. Empty is normal with cold caches.

panels.title: Secrets redacted / h
panels.description: Log-derived (Promtail): requests where hide-secrets redacted content before it left the box.

panels.title: Postgres / Redis latency p95
panels.description: From service_callback prometheus_system.

panels.title: Postgres / Redis failures / s
panels.description: From prometheus_system. Empty is normal when the backends are healthy.

panels.title: Spend-update queues
panels.description: Pending spend writes to Postgres; steady growth means DB writes are falling behind. Empty is normal until the first spend batch.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Loki job=litellm (health/metrics access lines dropped at Promtail). Unlabeled = plain uvicorn access lines.

panels.title: Warnings & errors
panels.description: Latest WARNING/ERROR lines. No prompt text is ever logged (turn_off_message_logging). Empty is normal in a quiet range.
